current.changeLog:
- Added a Leave Active Challenge option to remove a challenge from local resume history.
- Added automatic cleanup for cached challenges that no longer exist online.
- Fixed joined challenges inheriting old local MoE/reexperience progress.
- Challenge progress now starts from a race-owned 0-battle baseline.
- Hosted race progress now only advances from battles played after the challenge is active.
- Joining a challenge now registers the player on the hosted leaderboard immediately.
- Added a warning when the selected garage tank does not match the challenge tank.

previous.changeLog:
The modification now works correctly with XVM. The freeze during game loading has been fixed. However, XVM features for the tank carousel have been disabled.

Regarding any bugs, please send me a private message in-game.

Модификация теперь корректно работает с XVM. Устранено зависание при загрузке в игру. Однако функционал XVM для карусели танков отключён.

По поводу багов пишите в личные сообщения на мой игровой контакт.
